author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: a three-tier pile with concave notches between the tiers, an onion-dome top ending in a pointed tip, and a small S-shaped smell wisp beside it; reads as a poop pile, like the reference. The rejected drawing was a two-lobe cloud with a blob tip and a heavy comma wisp.
omissions: The reference's wisp sits above the pile's shoulder; it moves to the upper right corner to keep 9 from the dome, and it is shorter.
drawing_plan: SQUARE: bottom tier r5 semicircles at (11,37)/(37,37) and base y42; middle tier r5 arcs at (14,28)/(34,28); dome cubics (14,23)->(25,6)->(34,23); smell cubic (40,6)->(40,14).
lucide_reference: No Lucide poop; tiers built like Lucide 'cloud' lobes.
